bigint_u512.description: u512 = 4×u128 limbs; custom add/mul_small/div_small; binom iterative C(n,k)
bigint_u512.motivation: binom(465, k) for k≤99 reaches 343–344 bits; intermediate products ≤24×binom ~ 2^466; all fit in 512 bits
operations_not_needed: u512×u512 (too expensive, not required for CELL eval)

joint_ve_fix.description: Bug found and fixed in joint VE: x_mine and nbrs must be stored-only (set only in eliminate_variable, never in constraint_factor or join_factors). Original constraint_factor incorrectly computed x_mine/nbrs from live mask, causing double-counting when variables appear in multiple joined constraints.
joint_ve_fix.root_cause: constraint_factor set x_mine=mine_bit_at_var(mask), but eliminate_variable also added bit_val when eliminating x_var/neighbor. For shared variables (like x_var=225 appearing in both C0 and C1), this double-counted.
joint_ve_fix.fix: constraint_factor: always x_mine=0, nbrs=0. join_factors: simple le.x_mine+re.x_mine (safe since stored-only). eliminate_variable: unchanged (accumulates bit_val on elimination).
joint_ve_fix.secondary_fix: join_factors now takes x_var/neighbor_vars parameters to signal joint vs ordinary VE intent, though body uses simple addition in both cases.
